title: US-LatAm Interventions Update — May 19, 2026
summary: Cuba's energy crisis reached a critical threshold on May 14 as the Energy Minister declared all fuel reserves exhausted, with 20–22 hour blackouts nationwide — the direct result of Trump's EO 14380 oil blockade. CIA Director John Ratcliffe flew to Havana on May 14–15 for rare secret talks with Raúl Castro's grandson and Cuban intelligence chiefs, the highest-level US-Cuba intelligence contact in decades. Earlier, on April 16, US Treasury sanctioned Ortega's two sons and seven Nicaraguan gold mining companies in the broadest economic escalation against Managua since 2018. Paraguay on April 23 accepted the first 16 US third-country deportees under its 2025 bilateral agreement, and former Venezuelan spy chief Hugo Carvajal signaled willingness to testify against Maduro. KPIs, map points, political figures, and contested claims updated to reflect these developments.
